entries.title: Kessen

emulation.emulator: PCSX2; Sony PS2 Classics emulator on PS3 for the PSN release
emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 with an owned PS2 copy for high-resolution capture. The PS3 PS2 Classics version is an official but less flexible route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS2 assets and presentation with emulator-side resolution and filtering improvements.

primary.why: The PS2 original is the complete core release, and PCSX2 offers the best practical fidelity route from an owned copy; the later PS2 Classics release is an official access route but not a fidelity upgrade.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned PS2 copy on original hardware or use PCSX2 with an owned copy for cleaner capture. The Japanese PS2 Classics release is an alternate official PS3 route if available to the account.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PSN release is a PS2 Classics rerelease, not a remaster or remake.
